rule: a task's budget is the sum of its episodes' wall seconds (attribution's lifted episodes and re-runs included) in budget.json.  It is spent unit by unit (one run command; one record's attribution): a unit starts only if the task's spent core-hours plus the unit's estimate (its planned simulated seconds x the committed rates) fit; a started unit finishes; the first unit that does not fit is cut with every unit after it
